service: lopes-market-api

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs18.x
  environment:
    MONGO_URI: mongodb+srv://fullstack:fullstack@fullstack.lhqrvew.mongodb.net/?retryWrites=true&w=majority&appName=Fullstack

functions:
  api:
    handler: server.handler
    events:
      # User Registration (POST /register)
      - http:
          path: /users/register
          method: post
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # User Login (POST /login)
      - http:
          path: /users/login
          method: post
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # Get Current User 
      - http:
          path: /current-user
          method: get
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # Get User by Email (GET /users/{email})
      - http:
          path: /users/{email}
          method: get
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # Get Items in Cart (GET /users/{email}/cart)
      - http:
          path: /users/{email}/cart
          method: get
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # Add Item to Cart (PUT /users/{email}/cart)
      - http:
          path: /users/{email}/cart
          method: put
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # Delete Item from Cart (DELETE /users/{email}/cart/{id})
      - http:
          path: /users/{email}/cart/{id}
          method: delete
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # Prefetch CORS routes
      - http:
          path: /register
          method: options
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      - http:
          path: /login
          method: options
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # GET all products
      - http:
          path: /products
          method: get
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # POST a new product
      - http:
          path: /products
          method: post

          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # GET a specific product by ID
      - http:
          path: /products/{id}
          method: get
          integration: lambda
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # PUT a product by ID
      - http:
          path: /products/{id}
          method: put
          integration: lambda
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE

      # DELETE a product by ID
      - http:
          path: /products/{id}
          method: delete
          integration: lambda
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE
      # PREFLIGHT
      - http:
          path: /products
          method: options
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
          authorizationType: NONE
      - http:
          path: /products/{id}
          integration: lambda
          method: options
          cors:
            origin: '*'
            headers:
              - Content-Type
              - X-Amz-Date
              - Authorization
              - X-Api-Key
              - X-Amz-Security-Token
            allowCredentials: false
          authorizationType: NONE
